certificate.description: Signer bitmap (u64 big-endian bit length, then LSB-first bytes) and the 48-byte compressed aggregate G1 signature.

challenge_ack_fork_no_contradiction.description: The same acknowledgment on both sides. Authentic but not a fork.

challenge_ack_fork_proven.description: Two operator countersignatures for payer c at the same sequence number over different bodies. Proves the close invalid.

challenge_ack_fork_wrong_operator_role.description: The proven fork with the right-hand operator signature made under the send namespace. Rejected: InvalidOperatorSignature.

challenge_higher_ack_debit_no_contradict.description: Payer c's certified terminal acknowledgment. Authentic but consistent: the close stands.

challenge_higher_ack_debit_proven.description: Payer c's acknowledgment at seq terminal+1 with debit above the certified terminal debit. Proves the close invalid.

challenge_higher_ack_debit_wrong_payer_r.description: The proven HigherAckDebit evidence with the payer signature made under the ack namespace. Rejected: InvalidPayerSignature.

close_context.description: The context settlement bound at registration; the first part of the header preimage.

committee.description: Varint member count and compressed G2 keys in canonical order.

dealing.description: The operator's complete dealing every validator sealed.

genesis_state_root.description: Genesis balance root the deployment is configured with.

payout_claim.description: WithdrawalOutput (varint-length destination, u64 amount) then the Opening (u64 start, MMR proof) under the finalized payout head.

payout_opening.description: The opening alone, as embedded at the end of payout_claim.

root_bundle.description: Validator-derived successor roots; the second part of the header preimage.

settlement_chain_admitted.description: Settlement state immediately after admission, before finalization.

withdrawal_batch.description: Registered withdrawal boundary: the one operator-carried withdrawal.

format: Each *.hex file holds one 0x-prefixed lowercase hex string with no trailing newline. Integers inside crate encodings are fixed-width big-endian unless the type says varint. Every digest is SHA-256.

committee_commitment.description: Commitment to the canonical committee: varint member count then compressed G2 keys.

epoch_anchor.description: Payment anchor every acknowledgment and the header context bind.

header.description: Header digest. This is also the message the committee signs (see bls.header_message).

proposal_id.description: Identity of the dealing, carried in RootBundle.proposal.

terminal_batch_digest.description: Digest the operator signs over the epoch context and ordered terminal messages.

withdrawal_id.description: Replay identifier of the carried withdrawal.

key_derivation.accounts: curve25519 SigningKey::from_seed(seed + 1 + i) for a, b, c, d
key_derivation.validators: bls12381 Scalar::map("_PARADIGMHACK_BAJILLION_FIXTURE_VALIDATOR_KEY", seed_be || index_be), sorted by public key

admit.description: SettlementChain::admit at ADMIT_AT: header reconstruction, anchor, and batch id. The BLS certificate check hashes to G1 inside blst and is not part of this trace.

challenge_ack_fork_no_contradiction.description: SettlementChain::challenge_encoded at ADMIT_AT on the admitted chain: batch id lookup, header reconstruction, anchor, and every opening the evidence carries.

challenge_ack_fork_wrong_operator_role.description: SettlementChain::challenge_encoded at ADMIT_AT on the admitted chain: batch id lookup, header reconstruction, anchor, and every opening the evidence carries.

challenge_higher_ack_debit_wrong_payer_r.description: SettlementChain::challenge_encoded at ADMIT_AT on the admitted chain: batch id lookup, header reconstruction, anchor, and every opening the evidence carries.

claim_withdrawal.description: SettlementChain::claim_withdrawal: the payout opening's MMR walk under the finalized payout head, from the leaf preimage up to the root.

prepare_dealing.description: transition::prepare_dealing: payer vector roots and the terminal batch digest the operator signs.

register_epoch.description: SettlementChain::register_epoch at REGISTER_AT: boundary roots, anchor, and withdrawal intake.

settlement_new.description: SettlementChain::new: commits the committee once for the deployment.
